title: Sequence-Informed Geometric Evaluation of RNA 3D Structures
abstract: arXiv:2609.10644v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Computational RNA structure pipelines generate many candidate conformations for the same sequence. Reliable evaluation therefore requires more than recognising plausible geometry, it requires determining whether that geometry is compatible with the sequence. We introduce SIRGE, a sequence-informed geometric evaluator that conditions structural representations on nucleotide embeddings from a pretrained RNA language model. Early results show that SIRGE outperforms established evaluators in Kendall--$\tau$ alignment, Top-1 selection, and Top-3 ranking. Controlled comparisons further show that sequence conditioning corrects errors made by an otherwise matched geometric model and improves target-level rank structure. These findings provide initial evidence that pretrained sequence representations supply ranking information that complements geometric reasoning.

translated_title: 序列感知的RNA三维结构几何评估
translated_abstract: 计算RNA结构预测流程会为同一序列生成大量候选构象。因此，可靠的评估不仅要能够识别几何上合理的结构，还需要判断该几何结构是否与序列相容。我们提出了SIRGE，一种序列感知的几何评估器，它将结构表示条件化于来自预训练RNA语言模型的核苷酸嵌入。早期结果显示，SIRGE在Kendall-τ一致性、Top-1选择和Top-3排序方面优于现有的评估器。对照比较进一步表明，序列条件化能够纠正与之匹配的纯几何模型所犯的错误，并改善目标层面的排序结构。这些发现提供了初步证据，表明预训练的序列表示能够提供与几何推理互补的排序信息。
tldr: SIRGE利用预训练RNA语言模型的核苷酸嵌入来评估RNA三维结构与序列的兼容性，在排序和选择性能上超越现有评估器，证明序列信息可为几何评估提供互补的判别能力。
en_tdlr: SIRGE conditions geometric evaluation of RNA 3D structures on nucleotide embeddings from a pretrained RNA language model, outperforming existing evaluators in ranking and selection by leveraging sequence information that complements geometric reasoning.
